game_parquet_schema:
game_id: string
metadata: string
actions: list<item: uint16>
  child 0, item: uint16
-- schema metadata --
schema: 'human_v3'
encoder: 'pgx-v2-history8-ep-context8-v1'
action_map: 'pgx-2.6.0-chess-v2-uci-v1'
rules: 'tinychess-auto-fide-pgx-v1'
wdl_order: 'win,draw,loss'
legal_mask_bitorder: 'little'
feature_dtype: 'little_endian_float32'
position_parquet_schema:
game_id: string
source_month: string
split: string
ply: uint16
human_move_uci: string
action: uint16
outcome_stm: int8
wdl_class: uint8
value_weight: float
policy_weight: float
color: uint8
fen: string
repetition_count: uint8
position_hash: fixed_size_binary[32]
training_eligible: bool
remaining_plies: uint16
label_source: string
planes: fixed_size_binary[30720]
context: fixed_size_binary[32]
legal_mask: fixed_size_binary[584]
-- schema metadata --
schema: 'human_v3'
encoder: 'pgx-v2-history8-ep-context8-v1'
action_map: 'pgx-2.6.0-chess-v2-uci-v1'
rules: 'tinychess-auto-fide-pgx-v1'
wdl_order: 'win,draw,loss'
legal_mask_bitorder: 'little'
feature_dtype: 'little_endian_float32'
actions: native Pgx uint16 index sequence in ply order
legal_mask: 4672 bits, little bit order, no padding
value_weight: 0 for time forfeit, 1 otherwise; independent of win/draw/loss label
provenance: Per-game JSON metadata joined on unique game_id
horizon: reject >512 plies and any replay truncation; never create a truncation draw
early_environment_end: reject source continuations after genuine automatic board termination
full_legal_parity: all accepted pre-move positions plus final board checked offline; mismatch aborts entire extraction
storage_choice: materialized_position_parquet primary for measured random access; retain compact_game_parquet for replay/provenance
